svg.text: Inside the 300 x 200 x 130 box, lid off, seen from the front. Cable numbers W1-W13 match the cable schedule. Dimensions in mm.
A Interior layout and cable routing
M20 glands, all on the UNDERSIDE face. Nothing enters from above.
2 x 4 mm2 solar cable, MC4 pigtail pair
2 x 2.5 mm2 + inline 15 A blade fuse + ring terminals
USB-A to micro-USB (check the 4 Mini, it may be USB-C)
CRC9 male to SMA female pigtail
SMA m/f RG174 extension + SMA whip antenna
lavalier 3.5 mm TRS into a USB sound card
Also: bootlace ferrule kit, ring terminals, heatshrink, UV cable ties, self-amalgamating tape for the
antenna joint, nylon M2.5 standoffs for the Pi, adhesive tie mounts, a strap for the battery.
The buck hangs on the MPPT's LOAD output, not on the battery, so Victron's
low-voltage disconnect protects the cells. The probes hang there too, which is
how they stop drawing power for the 14 hours the node is asleep.
Both probes leave the factory on Modbus address 1. Re-address one to 2
(register 07D0) on the bench, or they collide on the bus and neither reads.
SEN0600 exposes moisture (0000H) and temperature (0001H) only. The agent's
generic-thc profile reads three registers and must be cut to two for this probe.
Wire colours on the probe tail are not published. Meter them before splicing:
the family convention is brown +V, black GND, yellow A, blue B.
The microphone is analogue on purpose. I2S is a board-level bus: it fails past roughly a metre, so an INMP441 cannot sit at the top of a 1500 mm whip. A lavalier capsule on
its own 6 m shielded lead, into a USB sound card in the box, is the version of this that works. That reverses the €3.10 microphone back to €45 of microphone plus card.
Nothing in this drawing is verified on hardware yet. Meter every colour and check every connector against the part in your hand before you cut anything.
